annotations.title: Get Web Analytics sources + AI referral attribution

description: Referrer/channel/UTM breakdown for a project's own tracking snippet, including AI referral attribution: aiReferral.bySource breaks the ai-referral channel out by assistant (chatgpt/claude/perplexity/gemini/copilot/you/poe). aiReferral.undercountNote is not decoration — industry measurement puts a large share of real AI-assistant referrals arriving with no referrer header at all, landing in the direct channel instead. This number is a measurable floor, never a complete count. FREE, first-party.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_web_analytics_sources
